title: Spec 014 Authorized Dependency Injection and Mount Readback

phases.objective: Inject one exact authorized mount bundle into the existing Tenant route dependency seam only after canonical readback proves the runtime identity, while preserving the default fail-closed route when no controller is supplied.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Authorized Dependency Injection Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The route resolves the non-enumerable synthetic-only tenantStorageRuntime only after exact mount readback and remains non-dispatching and non-production-ready.
steps: Start the Tenant route with an empty authorized dependency injection controller and prove HTTP 503.
Validate the canonical consumed mount bundle and all expected authorization, runtime, manifest, and generation bindings.
Create a secret-free exact mount readback and atomically expose the runtime through the controller.
Resolve the mounted runtime from the route using the fixed route path and dependency key.
Prove that the request reaches the mounted runtime without exposing the runtime in readback JSON.
assertions: No server bootstrap, migration, worker, provider, Hostinger, credential, or Production path is modified.
The route remains fail-closed when the controller is absent, invalid, unmounted, or rolled back.
The mounted runtime remains synthetic-only with provider dispatch and Production readiness false.
The mount readback is digest-bound to the authorized mount bundle and exact runtime identity.
Raw runtime material is non-enumerable and excluded from snapshots.

phases.objective: Persist and bootstrap the authorized mount controller in a live runtime only after schema, migration, deployment, worker, rollback, and provider prerequisites are separately authorized.
blockers: The durable mount-authorization registry schema remains unapplied.
No live server bootstrap creates or restores this controller.
No live runtime composition or credentials are available.
Provider dispatch and Production mutation remain forbidden.

phases.objective: Rollback to the fail-closed route and reconstruct the same mounted runtime from the exact bundle and mount readback after restart without consuming the authorization a second time.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Authorized Dependency Injection Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Rollback restores HTTP 503 and restart reconstruction restores the exact readback and runtime without a second registry write or authorization consumption.
steps: Bind rollback to the active injection ID and exact mount-readback digest.
Remove the runtime atomically and prove the route returns HTTP 503 again.
Create a fresh controller after simulated restart.
Validate the stored mount readback digest and exact bundle parity.
Restore the same route runtime while proving the durable consumption count and registry commit count do not increase.
assertions: A modified readback digest or bundle binding fails closed.
Rollback never enables Provider dispatch or Production readiness.
Restart reconstruction performs no second authorization consumption.
Automatic retry remains disabled and read-before-retry remains required.
